title: AuditWriteState
description: Fixed-size local write-date watermark for one audit collection. reserved_through is the highest UTC calendar day that has been durably reserved for append, not a signature, chain-head cache, or tamper-proof proof. Never includes absolute paths, credentials, account data, hashes, or raw log lines.

protocol_version.description: Watermark protocol version. Unknown versions are invalid.

base_name.description: Must equal the logical collection basename (for example audit.jsonl).

reserved_through.description: Highest UTC day reserved for writes, or null for a new empty collection. Calendar validity is enforced in code.
